root_cause.text: f2fs_rename performs on-disk directory modifications (updating target entry and deleting source entry) before attempting to add the whiteout entry, and when f2fs_add_link fails, it returns an error without invalidating the dentry cache, leaving stale dentries that point to an inode whose i_nlink has already been decremented to zero.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `d_invalidate(old_dentry)` and `d_invalidate(new_dentry)` in the error path of the whiteout addition (fs/f2fs/namei.c). The CVE description details that partial modifications are committed, VFS does not update the dentry cache due to the error, and subsequent renames against the stale dentry cause a WARNING in drop_nlink() when i_nlink reaches zero prematurely.
